narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Risk-Off
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as multi-front conflicts (Iran, Israel, Ukraine) escalate beyond controlled tit-for-tat, with real supply disruptions (Hormuz blockade, SPR release) and military incidents (Apache shootdown) confirming systemic risk. Markets are underpricing the duration and breadth of these conflicts, driving flows into safe havens.
narratives.trade_implication: Long VIX futures, short S&P 500 (SPY) with stop at 715, long gold (GLD) and short-dated Treasuries (SHY).

narratives.title: Energy Supply Shock Repricing
narratives.summary: Capital is rotating into energy commodities as the Hormuz blockade persists through Q3 2026 (EIA timeline), SPR releases signal bullish supply tightness, and infrastructure bypass talks (Kuwait-Saudi pipeline) indicate structural disruption. Markets are still pricing a diplomatic resolution that is unlikely near-term.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude futures (CL) and energy sector ETF (XLE), short refined products spreads (HO:RB) on refinery risk.

narratives.title: Crypto as Macro Risk Proxy
narratives.summary: Bitcoin's selloff mirrors broad risk-off moves, but whale accumulation and MicroStrategy buying suggest dip-buying by sophisticated capital. The narrative is shifting from crypto-specific to macro-driven, with potential for divergence if geopolitical tensions ease.
narratives.trade_implication: Accumulate BTC via futures (CME) on dips below $60K, hedge with short ETH/BTC ratio.
